Q044_addendum.material_fact_moved_to_context: Failed checks may retry with sufficient resources unless catastrophic
Q044_addendum.rationale: Q044 expressly selects guaranteed pre-check revenue, unrest from sixes/failure/tax, regional options and the success limit. The failure clause asks what unrest an unsuccessful check creates; it does not ask whether the Governor General can attempt another check. The success-limit clause limits successful Govern actions, not the number or permissibility of failed attempts. At most one successful Govern answers that clause fully. Resource-sufficient noncatastrophic retry permission is shared success-check procedure, explicitly requested by Q007, so it is contextual in Q044. Preserve all unrest triggers, distinct tax-region condition, regional options and the one-success cap. A materially false volunteered retry/attempt restriction remains a contradiction; no wrong-rule test is weakened.
